info.name: Red Hat Quay API
info.description:
The Red Hat Quay API provides programmatic access to the Quay container registry for managing container images, repositories, organizations, and security scanning results. It supports operations for image tagging, repository management, team permissions, robot accounts, and vulnerability scanning of container images.

Contact Support:
 Name: Red Hat Support
